Name: Tremendous Turkeys
Author: nugmods
Description:
There are a bunch of wild turkeys where I live now and it motivated me to make these sprites! This texture pack is for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25071]Mizu's Turkeys[/url], and I was graciously allowed to share. I was inspired by, and wanted to create sprites that matched, mods like siamece's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9057]Farm Animal Facelift[/url], omena007's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25134]Goose[/url], and cajcbell's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21024]Unique Horses[/url].

Original sprite work is by [url=https://ezekyuhl.itch.io/turkey-sprite-sheet]Ezekyuhl[/url], who provided these sprites for free use under a creative commons license. I used the feet and tail feathers from their sprite sheet, but redrew the body and head from scratch for chonkier turkeys.

Choose between the AT or Content Patcher versions of the mod, unzip it into your mod folder, and enjoy!

[b]Install:[/b]
Just put it in your mods folder, I promise it's that easy

Credits:
[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/MizuJakkaru?gameId=1303]Mizujakkaru[/url] - for the original turkey mod
